answer: Employer-anchored histories stop Sybils in four steps. First, a business registers an agent and signs its job record, so one operator cannot mint a fleet. Second, the employer files payroll proof tying the agent to work. Third, peers audit one record monthly; a mismatch freezes the agent ninety days. Fourth, fraud revokes the employer for a year and forfeits a $40 bond per agent. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 fake firms plus $100,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust is pigment ground slowly, a lantern lit nightly, and an ember kept by honest work, like a daily shopkeeper.
